status: Source baseline established; current screenshot references being reconciled by lead
authorityOrder: Approved DS React components and tokens

families.approvedPattern: WorkspacePageHeader app composition using Headings/M-bold, 32px/40px, white background, primary lower border and 24px vertical / 32px horizontal padding
variants: To Do retains its date below title
Freelancer Videos retains My jobs and its workflow
Project, profile, dialog and Client portal headings retain contextual hierarchies
families.rules: Scope is Videos, To Do, People, Clients, Media Library, Expenses and Brand Kits only. No supporting description except To Do date. Filters below header. People/Clients header search and filter-row invitation/create actions are settled.
families.authority: Docs/desktop-design-baseline.md - Workspace titles, search and page actions
families.conflicts: Older 32px Semibold and screenshot top-right roles are superseded; do not infer one universal heading size for all screens.

families.approvedPattern: DS Headings bold scale, contextual hierarchy
families.rules: Plus Jakarta Sans only; no custom font smoothing. Paragraph and Label XS 12/16, S 14/20, M16/24, L20/32, XL24/36, regular or semibold. Use paragraph for prose and label for UI text.
families.conflicts: Actual 10px/11px consumer styles are not new approved text styles merely because repeated. Audit their live use and task impact.

families.approvedPattern: DS Button, primary / secondary / tertiary / ghost / danger
families.canonicalExample: Role editor Remove role and Cancel
variants: S for dialog footers and compact toolbars
L for existing large entry actions
Ghost quiet actions intentionally have no frame at rest
families.rules: One main action per visible section; preserve meaning and callback. White secondary, purple primary, red danger. Native button, default type button. Rest no shadow; hover hard shadow; visible blue keyboard focus; pressed flattens. Consumer class controls layout only.
families.conflicts: Do not convert links, player controls, calendars, chips, grouped share actions or selection rows just because they contain words.

families.approvedPattern: DS IconButton quiet by default
families.rules: Required non-empty aria-label, DsIcon asset, no native title duplication. Blue focus on inner control. Quiet transparent at rest; lavender hover. Context-sized rather than globally enlarged.
families.conflicts: Pilot scope expanded through logged approvals, not all rich/composer/player controls. No X should be added to shared editing dialogs.

families.approvedPattern: DS Input with S/M/L variants and native attributes
families.rules: Associated label or accessible name; stable hint ids; invalid border and aria-invalid; blue focus, purple typing, lavender hover, disabled semantic tokens. Preserve validation and submission. Layout-only consumer classes.
families.conflicts: Search, inline editors, calendars/time, suggestion fields and rich composers are specialised. Team hours and currency fields remain unresolved audit scope, not automatically certified by EditingDialog. Current canonical capture requested.
families.inspectionNote: Current Studio name editor demonstrates labelled DS Input with initial keyboard focus; supplied frame is 1133px. Password fields and required-note error branches need separate checks.

families.approvedPattern: DS Textarea, Paragraph/S, token padding and small radius
families.rules: Vertical resize and native line breaks; no automatic growth. Native names/hints/errors/attributes and save boundaries retained. Read-only and disabled appearance follow Input.
families.conflicts: Chat, AI, Script, Brief, review and specialised Shoot composers/editors remain contextual. Different field heights are intentional. Current canonical capture requested.
families.captureLimit: Studio instructions DS Textarea default state only; focus, dirty and save/discard require interaction.

families.approvedPattern: Specialised current search compositions; no universal React Search primitive approved
families.canonicalExample: People/Clients search placement in workspace header
families.rules: Preserve actual query scope, callbacks, accessible name and result clearing. Shared header placement is approved; dimensions and all interaction styling are explicitly not blanket approved.
families.conflicts: Comparable workspace fields are 38/40/44px and vary in focus treatment. Need decision on a reusable interaction treatment without flattening specialised contexts or inventing an unapproved primitive.

families.approvedPattern: DS BriskSelect via compatibility re-export
families.canonicalExample: Videos Staff status field / People sort
variants: Search auto >15 or explicit for findable names
families.rules: White dark-bordered menu, 12px radius and hard shadow, 4px inset. Field/row radius8. Options minimum40px and wrap. Selected tick and lavender; separate blue active outline. Escape cancels uncommitted choice and restores focus. Preserve native semantics and portal/dismissal handling.
families.conflicts: Local CSS still overrides certain triggers and focus. Do not remove blue focus as an open-state decoration. Specialised calendar/time/address/mentions and visible Brief grids are excluded.
families.inspectionNote: The approved compact 584px Brand Kit field retains rich 72px options and useful palette content. Specialised two-column video/CTA/footage choice grids are not ordinary fields and fit both desktop widths. Brief table controls retain their approved component behaviour, but consumer widths hide short values at 1133 (A12).

families.approvedPattern: BriskSelect action mode, text-first quiet commands
families.canonicalExample: Recent pages / Script actions / Transcript actions
variants: Default menu width for long labels
families.rules: 44px minimum borderless rows, small DS text, no selected ticks or Done. Preserve disabled explanations, command order and callbacks. Arrow/Home/End/typeahead, Escape/focus return and Tab exit. Native anchors retain browser context/modifier clicks.
families.conflicts: Original Chat/Videos pilot and Script-only limits superseded by later scoped migrations. Specialised media source picker keeps four workflows; current canonical capture requested.
families.captureLimit: Closed Script actions trigger only, not menu-row verification.

families.approvedPattern: DS FilterGroup / FilterButton
families.rules: Native aria-pressed buttons in named group, no tab semantics or custom arrow selection. Minimum44px,14px semibold, counts12px including0. Lavender selected, blue focus, wrap rather than clip.
families.conflicts: Videos detailed Filters, Freelancer job/payment views, Chat Internal/External, Shoot modes/day and media/player tools remain specialised. Their differences are not automatically defects.

families.approvedPattern: DS Tabs, underlined quiet choice
families.rules: Named tablist, native buttons, one tab stop, stable ids, labelled active panel. Left/Right/Home/End focus and activate instant panels. Preserve consumer state and existing URL/refresh rules. No attached frame inferred from older Figma tabs.
families.conflicts: Team Staff/Freelancers custom selector remains explicitly unresolved; migrating must preserve different selection/assign/invite behaviours. Current canonical capture requested.
families.captureLimit: Profile Overview tab strip default state only; keyboard behaviour not proven by screenshot.

families.approvedPattern: DS Checkbox,20px square and44px minimum clickable row
families.rules: Approved check SVG through DsIcon, mixed bar, native Space and DS Enter shortcut, blue visible focus. Preserve boolean onChange, scope, persistence and save/cancel semantics. Consumer controls layout only.
families.conflicts: Team selector duplicates a24px target with Unicode tick, outside approved states. Current canonical capture requested; see A02/B accessible-name finding.
families.captureLimit: Current checked/disabled default states; keyboard focus and actual target measurement require browser.

families.approvedPattern: DS Radio single-size20px circle and44px target
families.rules: Preserve fieldset/legend, shared native name per exclusive group, distinct names across groups. Browser owns arrows, Space and reset. No mixed or Enter shortcut. Blue focus and shared semantic tokens.
families.conflicts: Specialised Brief choice grids, filters and voice/icon/sharing choices are outside initial migration. Current canonical capture requested.

families.approvedPattern: DS Toggle immediate on/off
families.canonicalExample: Chat connector Use for this project
families.rules: Native checkbox role switch, native Space. Disabled semantic tokens not whole-control opacity. Visible blue focus. Save-based forms use Checkbox; preserve immediate-update callbacks and close behaviour.
families.conflicts: Chat approved immediate setting remains saved when closed with Cancel; do not silently add rollback through a visual migration. Current canonical capture requested.

families.approvedPattern: DS EditingDialog / DialogSurface
families.rules: White primary-bordered12px surface, hard shadow,24px padding/gaps,20px bold title,14px prose. No top-rightX/decorative icon/divider. Visible S actions right; Cancel before Save. Scroll body with stable title/footer. Native modal focus containment; Escape/backdrop original guard; restore opener.
families.conflicts: Approval of shell does not certify Team contents or combine distinct save, invite, assign and remove actions. Drawers, read-only previews and contextual inline editors remain separate.

families.approvedPattern: DS ConfirmationDialog
variants: Expanded680 for recipients, typed confirmation and message
families.rules: Same shell as editor, Cancel first and default focus, red destructive versus purple positive. Accurate consequences and recovery. Disabled cannot be bypassed by Enter. Nested cancellation preserves draft. Never submit merely to inspect.
families.conflicts: Studio Settings browser history/reload warnings retain documented native synchronous exception. Older generic Popconfirm placement does not revoke newer React confirmation standard. Current canonical capture requested.
families.inspectionNote: Current expanded ConfirmationDialog has explicit comparison facts, named warning, note requirement and visible Cancel. This does not approve every custom footer: Send back and other consumers need explicit-exit review.

families.approvedPattern: DS Popover composed with Checkbox and Button
variants: Done for immediate changes and existing Reset
families.rules: White primary border12px radius hard shadow. Non-modal labelled dialog, not menu/listbox. Focus first enabled field, normal Tab exit, Escape/Done focus return, viewport fitting. Preserve fixed columns and last optional-column guard.
families.conflicts: Pilot only Videos Columns; not general permission to migrate all specialised pickers. Current canonical capture requested.

families.approvedPattern: Contextual app drawers informed by d-Drawer; no generic React Drawer export in kit
families.rules: Retain contextual workflow; white surface, primary border and appropriate elevation. Original kit drawer top-left16px corner with other corners sharp. Preserve nested menus, sections and interaction guards.
families.conflicts: Existing code is evidence, not blanket approval of every drawer shape. No DS Drawer React implementation available, so do not recommend a nonexistent import or silently invent one.

families.approvedPattern: Structured native tables/app compositions using DS foundations; d-Table catalogue is Figma guidance
variants: Videos sticky Project/Actions and reorderable optional columns
families.rules: Use meaningful headings and native destinations. Row typography and density contextual. Keep hairlines without nested card frames around each Videos item. Do not remove financial or capacity distinctions for uniformity.
families.authority: data-display.md; desktop baseline; scoped decision log
families.conflicts: No React Table export exists. Treat shared table architecture as an unresolved DS/source-sync question, not a demand to replace working native tables with nonexistent code. Horizontal scrolling can be intentional; verify discoverability and fixed-column fit at1133.
families.inspectionNote: 30 September decisions explicitly retain one Main Video Details row, shared headings/column positions with Additional Versions, and the editor field order. Retain these while repairing short-value truncation and mid-word wrapping at narrow desktop (A12); no new card/table primitive is implied.

families.approvedPattern: Semantic DS colours, primary enclosing edges, hard elevated shadows
variants: Specialised status/comment tints per scoped references
families.rules: No blurred or multistack shadow. Hard M4/4 elevation, S2/2. Controls rest no shadow; elevated surfaces rest M. Primary border on active enclosing edge; secondary border disabled-only per DS. Radius and spacing tokens, distinguish enclosing edges from content hairlines.
families.conflicts: Shoot softer-surface overrides include disabled border tokens and blurred shadow declarations; live use and any scoped approval need verification. Do not apply generic enclosure border rules to approved quiet menus/buttons or add double borders.
families.inspectionNote: A06 concerns decorative enclosing Brand Kit layers. Actual colour swatches, logo preview backgrounds, font specimens, status colours and the shared call-sheet call-time emphasis serve content semantics and are not blanket white-only targets.

families.approvedPattern: Contextual app badges; global Chat/Updates share CommentCountBadge
variants: Unread global counts with separate sources
Role/access badges when access distinction matters
families.rules: Preserve zero hiding, caps, aria labels and independent counts. Existing globals sharing adapter is approved; specific10px white/Pink40 and animation remain audit subjects. Status selection and read-only pills serve distinct jobs.
families.authority: desktop baseline - Global unread counts; data-display.md; shared Videos status approval
families.conflicts: No reusable React Badge exported; current adapter is not a new DS variant. Original screenshot cannot itself authorise low contrast or perpetual motion.

families.approvedPattern: Circular StageChip and native ProjectStageHeader links
families.rules: Status colour independent of viewed page. Equal circle/icon size; selected page primary text+purple underline, no lifting/enlarging. Native links and aria-current, not content Tabs. Status treatment remains purpose-specific in list versus header.
families.conflicts: Archived Flow icons, square/letter tiles, Style Frames and separate Shoot Plan/On Set project stages are superseded. Historical screenshot Media in sequence is not current authority.
families.captureLimit: Project stage label selection and pinned Media shown; does not prove all supported flows.

families.approvedPattern: HybridSidebar plus AppShell app composition
families.rules: Staff order Videos,To Do,People,Clients,Media Library,Expenses,Brand Kits. Back/Forward/Recent top-left. Chat and Updates visible labels and icons top-right, quiet Ask Brisk. Account above Studio settings and quiet Test mode below. Sidebar secondary neutral; top/content white.
families.conflicts: Do not homogenise destinations by granting inaccessible content. Older AppSidebar/WorkspaceSidebar need live/unused classification; not automatic migration target. Current notification descendants lose settings context because of an exact route match; see A05.

families.approvedPattern: DsIcon mapped approved assets in public/brisk-icons; StageChip owns stages
families.canonicalExample: Hybrid sidebar Clients buildings / Expenses money / Brand Kits palette
families.rules: No third-party/Unicode/emoji UI substitutes or inline paths. Missing asset protocol requires reporting missing need and Yura confirmation before implementation; audit may document recommendation only. Logos and supplied pictograms keep identity.
families.conflicts: Team checkbox uses Unicode check despite approved DS asset; do not substitute custom new tick.

families.approvedPattern: Contextual DS-informed empty states and field feedback; no generic React EmptyState/Toast exports
families.canonicalExample: To Do existing unassigned-person empty state
variants: Restricted scope with reason and safe destination
families.rules: Short headline, one-line useful explanation and appropriate next action. Do not force a create CTA into read-only/restricted context. Important actionable information persists; ordinary transient success can dismiss. Preserve accurate saves and recovery, never imply nonexistent Undo.
families.authority: brisk-design-system.md; saas-patterns; overlays.md; scoped availability decisions
families.conflicts: Figma Toast/Alert catalogue does not prove reusable React exports. Blank suggested Staff branch is a candidate; do not manufacture failures or records for evidence. Current canonical capture requested.

families.approvedPattern: Specialised approved Brisk visual references plus contextual source
families.canonicalExample: Video Review dark player/light comment rail
variants: Client cream versus team lavender comments
Transcript source metadata and Send to Script working version
families.rules: Preserve differentiated message visibility and approval/review function. Detail actions retain hierarchy, with at most one primary in current action section. Media/transcripts retain source scope; historical Script versions are read-only. Specialised editor controls are not ordinary button/field migrations.
families.authority: brisk-design-system.md - Video Review; action-menus.md; production journey
families.conflicts: Historical screenshot supports dark/light contrast and comment family, not current nav/heading/role controls. Current capture needed for live comparison.

reviewBoundaries: Source review and genuine historical/current screenshots only. Browser lead must bind requested canonical captures and verify focus/cascade. No app edits, stored-data changes, commits, installs, tests or production build. No proposed pattern is approved on Tom's behalf.
